### Root Cause of the Docking Jump
1. **Inline-block baseline shift (`overflow: hidden`)**: In [intro.css](file:///c:/Users/thatp/Documents/projects/slothlab/box-split-visual/explorables/box-split-grammars/demo/intro/intro.css), `.dock-label` was styled as `display: inline-block; overflow: hidden; vertical-align: baseline;`. In CSS, an `inline-block` with non-`visible` `overflow` uses its **bottom margin edge** as its baseline rather than its text baseline—keeping the bold label aligned near the top while pushing `.dock-text` down below the resting `.term-body` line.
2. **Double-layer crossfade**: `dockBubbleIntoBullet` in [dom.js](file:///c:/Users/thatp/Documents/projects/slothlab/box-split-visual/explorables/box-split-grammars/demo/intro/dom.js) previously cross-faded `#dock-bubble` against `bulletEl` over `t = 0.86..1.0`, exposing both the vertical jump and a momentary opacity dip.
